description: Defines classes and interfaces for creating and managing HTTP authentication handlers, including factory classes for different schemes like Basic, Digest, NTLM, and Negotiate. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and factory registration mechanisms.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerFactory
classes.description: Abstract factory class for creating HttpAuthHandler objects based on authentication challenges.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerRegistryFactory
classes.description: Dispatches creation requests to specific scheme factories based on the auth scheme.

methods.name: CreateAuthHandler
methods.description: Creates an HttpAuthHandler based on a challenge challenge token.

methods.name: CreateAuthHandlerFromString
methods.description: Creates an HttpAuthHandler from a challenge string.

methods.name: CreatePreemptiveAuthHandlerFromString
methods.description: Creates a preemptive HttpAuthHandler from a challenge string.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a default HttpAuthHandlerRegistryFactory with support for common schemes.

methods.name: RegisterSchemeFactory
methods.description: Registers a factory for a specific authentication scheme.

methods.name: GetSchemeFactory
methods.description: Retrieves the factory associated with a specific scheme.
